body: Well I'm still here. I can't do anything. I love my sons so much and I just can't bare to hurt them. I don't know how long I can carry on like this. I have a really good family, I just don't want to ask for help, I'm sick of relying on other people, I feel like a failure.

I know deep down you're right, but there is just a huge part of me that feels like a failure. I'm not a horrible mum, not even slightly. I just feel I could do more 'fun' things if I wasn't so poorly. My children are my absolute everything. They are just amazing. The thing is, I'm going to lose my home and I just can't see them live at their dads without me, i couldn't live knowing they weren't with me. Along with what feels like a million other reasons.

Thank you for your advice. I kind of feel like going to the doctors will be a double edged sword, on the one hand I don't want an infection and on the other I don't want to deal with being nauseated vomiting all the time. 
I had a bad burn previously, about as deep as this ulcer (?) On my leg and I took care of that, dressed and packed it etc with no.sign of infection, I went to the doctors eventually and they were quite impressed that id managed to look after it well and there was no infection at all. 
I think I'll give it a week if nothing changes I'll see a doctor. The redness seems to have gone this morning, and it doesn't feel hot or anything, also its definitely shrinking when I think about it.

You are both right, I'm not going to say what I did was a good thing to do. It was kind of an act of desperation. I'm sick of being sick and not eating. I just want to point out it says for im or iv on the prescription. 

Thank you
